title: Expressions of Interest - civil engineering, drafting and support (Brisbane or Melbourne)
content_text:
Expressions of Interest - Bornhorst + Ward
Brisbane QLD / Melbourne VIC
Are you passionate about engineering, drafting, or supporting innovative projects? Bornhorst + Ward, a trusted name in civil and structural engineering for 60 years, welcomes expressions of interest from individuals keen to join our dynamic team.
Whether you're an experienced professional or just starting your career, we offer opportunities across a range of roles in civil and structural engineering, drafting, and support functions.
Key Responsibilities may include: engineering designs, technical drawings, project planning; AutoCAD, Revit, and other BIM software; multidisciplinary collaboration; site visits; continuous improvement.
About You: interest in engineering and construction; strong communication; willingness to learn; CAD software (AutoCAD, Revit, or similar) a plus; collaborative.
Whether you're a recent graduate, an experienced professional, or someone looking to transition into a new career path, we'd love to hear from you.
Apply via company Apply Now form at https://www.bornhorstward.com.au/apply with cover letter and resume.
Note: This position is available only to candidates with unrestricted working rights in Australia.
Melbourne office: L4 - 400 Collins Street, Melbourne, VIC 3000
Brisbane: L14 - 133 Mary Street, Brisbane, QLD 4000
Email: mail@bornhorstward.com.au
Phone: (07) 3013 4699
Cadet Drafting Program noted on careers page (2027 intake opens early 2027); this EOI covers drafting and early career interest now.
